modules.name: Git workflow
modules.description: Commit discipline, branching, merge gating, .gitignore hygiene, dependency-upgrade caution.

modules.name: Security
modules.description: Secrets/.env, logs, browser profile data, out-of-project access, exposed-credential handling.

modules.name: Docker networking
modules.description: Port-publishing defaults, internal-only networking, and required (${VAR:?...}) compose env vars.

modules.name: Process tiers
modules.description: Decide-vs-ask, task-size tiers, sub-agent delegation (incl. shared-code location upfront), conflict-resolution worked examples, reporting shape.

modules.name: Code quality
modules.description: Architecture, coding principles, fail-loud error handling, import/typing discipline (no unused params, no trivial wrappers, no single-use helpers, typed payloads, no exception-to-bool), single-source contracts (incl. Exceptions/BaseModels, no duplicated SERVICE_NAME), lint/format/type-check order, fresh-eyes review.

modules.name: Testing
modules.description: Coverage, UX-level pass, service-boundary respect, baseline regression checks, fair comparisons, environment-vs-code failure triage.

modules.name: Logging
modules.description: Structured logging, one Processor TypeAlias and correlation ID across services, no wrapper-forwarding processors, Telegram as an alert channel.

modules.name: External integrations
modules.description: Wiring-only for a decided integration (retry, docs-first, Telegram topics, heartbeat, portrait defaults). No search, no stack picks.

modules.name: Proxy egress
modules.description: Mandatory outbound proxy with no silent direct fallbacks. Per-client-library proxy behavior, fallback hunting with grep patterns, live verification from inside a container. Asks where the proxy lives rather than hardcoding it.
